prompt: What happens if we don't complete our SWIFT attestation by December 31?
assertions: States the window: attest/re-attest between July and December, no later than December 31, against the current CSCF version
States the independent assessment requirement: every attestation must be supported by an independent assessment (Independent Assessment Framework)

Gives the real consequences: Swift reports non-compliant/non-attested users to their financial supervisor via a dedicated real-time application, and attestation status is visible to counterparties in KYC-SA — the published lever is reporting/visibility, not disconnection

Lists the reportable conditions accurately (no valid attestation, non-compliance with mandatory controls, no independent assessment, non-compliant service provider connection, or failure to complete a Swift-mandated external assessment)
Gives practical advice: book assessors early (Q4 capacity crunch), and new joiners must attest before going live
